privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Chalkpis ("we", "us") is built and run by M2W Technologies Private Limited (Man2Web), India. This policy explains what information the Chalkpis app and website handle, why, and the choices you have. If anything here is unclear, write to hello@chalkpis.com.

p: Teachers and centres who sign up for Chalkpis ("you"): tuition and coaching centres, abacus, karate, dance, yoga and music classes, sports academies and the like; the helpers they invite; and the students and parents whose details a centre adds to the app.
For student and parent details, the teacher or centre decides what is entered and why; we process those details on the centre's behalf to run the service.
About you: your name, mobile number, institute name, address, phone, logo, UPI id and payment link (if you add them), and your plan.
Sign-in: you sign in with your mobile number and a code sent on WhatsApp. Sign-in codes are stored only as one-way hashes and expire within minutes.

About your students and their parents, as entered by you: names, class, batches, parent name and mobile number, optional student phone, date of birth, gender, photo and notes; attendance; fees, discounts, payments and receipts.
Messages: a log of WhatsApp messages sent to parents (type, time, status and the last 4 digits of the number). The message values are deleted once a message is sent or has failed.
Technical: sign-in sessions and basic server logs needed to keep the service secure. We do not use advertising trackers and we do not sell personal data.
To run the app for you: keep student records, attendance and fees, make receipts and reports, and show parents their child's details on a private link you choose to share.
To send WhatsApp messages you have switched on or asked for (absent and late alerts, fee reminders with your UPI QR or payment link, receipts, parent page links) and your sign-in codes.
To keep the service safe, fix problems and meet legal duties.

WhatsApp messages are sent from our business number through the WhatsApp Business Platform (Meta) and our messaging partner ValueFirst Digital Media. They receive the parent's number and the message text needed to deliver it.
Our servers are hosted by our cloud provider. App updates are delivered through Expo (EAS).

Plan payments on our website are handled by Razorpay. Subscriptions in the iPhone and Android apps are handled by Apple (App Store) or Google (Google Play), and their status reaches us through RevenueCat, which receives your centre's account number in Chalkpis and the purchase details (never your card, UPI or bank details). We never see your card, UPI or bank details.
Tuition fees go straight from parents to your own UPI id or payment page. Chalkpis never receives or holds that money.
We share information with authorities only when the law requires it.

We keep your data while your account is open. When you delete your account (Account > Delete my account), your institute, students, attendance, fees, messages and pictures are removed from our live systems straight away.
Encrypted backups are kept for up to 14 days and then deleted. Plan payment records may be kept longer where tax law requires it.

All traffic is encrypted (HTTPS). Every record belongs to one institute and the server checks that on every request, so one centre can never see another centre's data. Parent links are long secret links that you can switch off at any time; parent pages never show phone numbers or notes.

Chalkpis is used by teachers and centres, not by children. Centres add student details for their classes and fee records and are responsible for having the parent's consent to do so and to message them on WhatsApp, as required by the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
You can see, correct or delete the details you entered at any time in the app, and switch parent messages off (for everyone or for one student).
Parents and students can ask their teacher or centre to correct or remove their details, or write to us and we will help the centre do so.
You can delete your account in the app at any time.
We may update this policy. We will show the new date at the top and tell you in the app if the changes are important.
Grievance Officer, M2W Technologies Private Limited (Man2Web). Email: hello@chalkpis.com. We reply within 7 days and resolve complaints within 30 days.

terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.intro: These terms are an agreement between you and M2W Technologies Private Limited (Man2Web), India, who build and run Chalkpis. By creating an account or using the app you accept them. Questions: hello@chalkpis.com.

p: Chalkpis helps tuition and coaching centres, abacus, karate, dance and yoga classes, sports academies and other teachers keep student records, attendance and fees, send WhatsApp updates to parents, make receipts, reports and posters, and share a private parent page.
You sign in with your mobile number and a one-time code. Keep your phone secure; you are responsible for what is done with your account, including by helpers you invite.
You must give correct details and be at least 18 years old.
You own the information you enter. You give us permission to store and process it only to run Chalkpis for you, as described in the Privacy Policy.
You confirm that you have the parent's consent to keep their child's details and to send them messages on WhatsApp, and that the details you enter are accurate.
Use parent messages only for genuine tuition updates. Do not send spam, unlawful, misleading or offensive content.

Parents pay you directly through your UPI id or your own payment page. Chalkpis is not a party to those payments, does not hold the money and is not responsible for refunds or disputes between you and parents. Check that your UPI id is correct.
New accounts start with a free trial; no payment details are needed for it. Prices and limits of each plan are shown before you pay.

In the iPhone and Android apps, plans are monthly or yearly subscriptions bought through the App Store or Google Play. They renew automatically at the price shown until you cancel, and are charged to your Apple ID or Google account. You can cancel or change a subscription at any time in your Apple ID or Google Play settings, at least 24 hours before it renews; the plan then runs to the end of the period already paid. If an introductory price is shown (for example a lower first month), it applies once and the subscription then renews at the normal price. Refunds for these purchases are handled by Apple or Google under their own policies.

On our website, plans are monthly or yearly subscriptions that renew automatically by UPI Autopay or a card mandate you approve on Razorpay's page, until you turn auto-renew off on the website or cancel the mandate in your UPI app or with your bank. The first payment is taken when your free trial or current plan ends (when you upgrade, at once, with the unused days of your old plan credited), then at the start of every month or year; you are told before each payment. If an automatic payment fails it is retried, and if it keeps failing your plan simply ends on its paid date. A yearly plan can also be paid once, without auto-renewal. If you have days left on a free trial or a website plan when you subscribe in the app, those days are kept and resume after the subscription ends.
When a plan ends, your records stay readable but you cannot add or change them until you choose a plan again.
Messages are sent from our business number using templates approved by WhatsApp. Delivery depends on WhatsApp and the parent's phone; we cannot promise that every message is delivered or read.
Do not try to access other accounts, break or overload the service, copy the app, or use it for anything illegal. We may suspend accounts that do.

We work to keep Chalkpis available and your data safe, with daily backups, but the service is provided "as is" and may sometimes be unavailable. We may improve or change features; we will give notice of important changes.
To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for indirect losses, lost income or lost data, and our total liability is limited to the amount you paid us in the 3 months before the claim.
You can delete your account at any time in the app. We may close accounts that break these terms. On deletion your data is removed as described in the Privacy Policy.
These terms are governed by the laws of India, and the courts of India have jurisdiction.
M2W Technologies Private Limited (Man2Web). Email: hello@chalkpis.com.
